captures.observation: When not cancelled and both context pointers exist, each non-null request in the pending range is detached, polled with one-microsecond sleeps, its result and size stored in staging arrays, and deleted. Calls cleanup unconditionally, then schedules wrapper 0x1445df9a0 on render and 0x1445df910 on the context thread.
Closure dereferences captured this, invokes cleanup and schedules no normal task; cancellation wrapper 0x1445df910 is scheduled on the context thread.
Iterates the pending range; for each request, polls, cancels and waits with zero timeout if incomplete, deletes and clears the slot.
Thunk to 0x1445d99b0, confirmed DoExpandResources by stat.
Forwards captured this to 0x1445e35e0, matching 4.26 DoCancel.
Named by stat as DoExpandResources; calls 0x1445e8fe0 and queues wrapper 0x1445dfb40 on render and 0x1445df910 on context thread.
Calls 0x142bee710 on each of eight staging pointers, clears each pointer and size, then calls 0x1445e44a0 with context. Free and DoFinishUpdate names inferred from 4.26.

If not cancelled with proxy and render data, sums low 32 bits of staging sizes in descending pending range, creates and locks expanded buffer if size changed, copies positive-size staging data and frees it, unlocks and queues old buffer copy.

When uncancelled and context has proxy and render data, updates memory stat and batches resource replacement if intermediate buffer exists, sets first LOD and proxy resident count. Releases intermediate buffer unconditionally.

limitations: RHI operations and FMemory::Free map to the 4.26 analogue; exact ABI and proxy cached-resident access still require integration confirmation.
